An aircraft is moving at 60m/s in a northerly direction when a cross-wind from the east starts to
blow. The speed of the wind is 13m/s.
What is the magnitude of the aircraft’s velocity when the wind is blowing?
A
47m/s
B
59m/s
C
61m/s
D
73m/s
subject: Physics
